mapper.insert: INSERT INTO qa_history(user_id, session_id, question, answer, references_json, status, error_message, create_time) VALUES(#{userId}, #{sessionId}, #{question}, #{answer}, #{referencesJson}, #{status}, #{errorMessage}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE qa_history SET status = #{status}, answer = #{answer}, references_json = #{referencesJson}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM qa_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 100
